errors.text_span: wobei die dunkelblauen Balken (Produzierendes Gewerbe) in den meisten Fällen die längsten sind
errors.evidence: This statement claims that the dark blue bars are the longest in most cases. However, they are the longest in only 2 out of 5 categories. In the 'Plattformdienste' category, the light blue bar is the longest. In 'Audiovisuelle Technologien', the gray bar is the longest. In 'Künstliche Intelligenz', the light blue bar is the longest.

errors.text_span: 'Plattformdienste' weisen mit etwa 62 % im produzierenden Gewerbe den höchsten Anteil auf
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the bar with the highest value. The highest share in the chart belongs to 'Dienstleistungen ohne öffentlichen Dienst' (light blue bar) in the 'Plattformdienste' category, with a value of approximately 67%, not the 'produzierendes Gewerbe' (dark blue bar) which is at about 63%.

errors.text_span: während 'Künstliche Intelligenz' mit etwa 7 % im produzierenden Gewerbe den niedrigsten Wert darstellt
errors.evidence: The description states the lowest value is approximately 7% for 'Künstliche Intelligenz' in 'produzierendes Gewerbe'. The actual value shown in the chart for this bar is approximately 6%. Furthermore, this is not uniquely the lowest value, as other bars are also at 6%.

The description incorrectly states that the bars are not sorted. The categories on the y-axis are sorted in descending order of magnitude, which is a key visual feature of the chart that has been missed and contradicted.
